extraction_notes: P-channel quantities are recorded as positive magnitudes for extraction and model fitting; the datasheet publishes the corresponding electrical polarities as negative values.
Transfer, output, capacitance, and gate-charge curves are approximate digitizations from the typical-characteristics figures on p. 3; axes and stated test conditions are retained.
The datasheet publishes VGS(th) MIN = -0.3 V and MAX = -0.9 V at VDS = VGS and ID = -250 uA; no typical threshold value is published, so threshold_typ is null.

The RDS(on) table publishes maximum limits of 0.043 ohm at |VGS| = 4.5 V and |ID| = 4.0 A, 0.055 ohm at |VGS| = 2.5 V and |ID| = 4.0 A, 0.075 ohm at |VGS| = 1.8 V and |ID| = 2.0 A, and 0.100 ohm at |VGS| = 1.5 V and |ID| = 1.0 A. The rdson_points values are typical estimates digitized from Fig. 3.

The capacitance table publishes Ciss minimum 600 pF and maximum 905 pF, Coss minimum 80 pF and maximum 150 pF, and Crss minimum 48 pF and maximum 115 pF at VDS = -10 V, VGS = -10 V, and f = 1 MHz. The represented values are typical estimates digitized from Fig. 5 at |VDS| = 10 V.

The switching table publishes Qg = 7.4 nC minimum and 11 nC maximum, Qgs = 0.8 nC minimum and 1.2 nC maximum, Qgd = 1.3 nC minimum and 3.1 nC maximum, Qrr = 40 nC minimum and 62 nC maximum, and trr = 20 ns minimum and 32 ns maximum. The supplied schema has no dedicated fields for these quantities.

The thermal table publishes RthetaJA = 357 K/W maximum for the stated FR-4 board mounting; no RthetaJC value is published. The off-state table publishes |IDSS| <= 1.0e-6 A at |VDS| = 20 V and VGS = 0 V. Gate leakage, transconductance, maximum body-diode current, and switching timing rows are not represented by the supplied schema.

The safe operating area and normalized transient thermal impedance plots were examined but are not included as model-fitting curves because the supplied schema has no dedicated SOA or thermal-impedance fields.
omission_reason: The supplied schema has no fields for gate charge, reverse-recovery charge/time, leakage, transconductance, temperature coefficients, maximum body-diode current, switching timing, or thermal resistance; those published values are retained only in extraction_notes.
